sourceSentences: Quinn dashes to the target enemy, marking them with Harrier, dealing physical damage, knocking them back a very short distance over 0.5 seconds, and slowing them by 50% decaying over 1.5 seconds.
Vault resets Quinn's remaining attack cooldown a short delay after the first dash ends (even if interrupted).
This delay is a fuzzy 0.25 to 0.5 seconds and this matches up with the moment the target of Vault is marked with Harrier.
Quinn will automatically attempt to attack the target once she completes Vault.

Unlike its constant cast range Vault's bounce's can vary to allow Quinn to close or to make a gap between herself and the target (depending on casting position) or even to jump through a wall (if there is enough landing room on the other side).
Vault's knock back also interrupts the windup of basic attacks with uncancellable windups.
Behind Enemy Lines can be recast after 0.5 seconds during the channel.
Behind Enemy Lines does not refund its mana cost if the channel was canceled via recast.
Taking damage from non-minions while Behind Enemy Lines is active or while Quinn is channeling the ability causes her to lose the bonus total movement speed for 3 seconds.
Once Behind Enemy Lines has been learned, respawning or entering any summoning platform will spawn Valor instantly.
However, it will still automatically activate upon declaring a basic attack or casting Blinding Assault or Vault.
Whenever Quinn uses a basic attack against a target marked by Harrier or consumes their mark, she gains bonus attack speed and bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.

For combos, your basic go-to is to attack into E, then attack into Q before attacking away. And your all-in is to ultimate and then cancel it when in range to attack. Follow up with Q and attack before Eing and attacking away.
In addition, if she attacks, uses Q or E, she also casts this ability and ends it.
With Quinn, you should always auto attack before and after each ability so you can use Quinn's passive and marks every time you hit your abilities.
If you attack, it will end the ability, dealing damage and applying a mark to your enemies.
